## Summary
The Deployment `eval-crashloop` in namespace `eval-live-fixture` on cluster `alpha17-lab` is unavailable (0/1 replicas) because its single pod is in a CrashLoopBackOff. The pod's container `app` (busybox:1.36) exits immediately with `FATAL: environment variable REQUIRED_SETTING is not set` because the startup command requires the env var `REQUIRED_SETTING`, which is not defined anywhere in the Deployment spec or pod environment.

## Incident key
gitlab-whisky/alpha17-lab/eval-live-fixture/Deployment/eval-crashloop/rollout_unavailable

## Evidence
- `k8s_get_resources` (deployment): `eval-crashloop` shows `READY 0/1`, `UP-TO-DATE 1`, `AVAILABLE 0`, age 16m, image `busybox:1.36`.
- `k8s_get_resource_yaml` (deployment): The container command is `sh -c 'if [ -z "$REQUIRED_SETTING" ]; then echo "FATAL: environment variable REQUIRED_SETTING is not set" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 3600'`; the spec defines no `env` entries, so `REQUIRED_SETTING` is always unset. Status condition `Available=False`, reason `MinimumReplicasUnavailable`, `unavailableReplicas: 1`.
- `k8s_get_resources` (pods): pod `eval-crashloop-7977dcfd94-mpt95` is in `Error` status with 8 restarts; the sibling pod `eval-distractor-5b68dbb8df-2jsvw` is `1/1 Running` (not part of this finding).
- `k8s_get_events` (namespace): repeated `BackOff` Warning events — "Back-off restarting failed container app in pod eval-crashloop-7977dcfd94-mpt95" (count 15, from 21:53:35Z through 22:08:51Z); preceding `Scheduled`/`Pulled`/`Created`/`Started` events are all Normal and successful, ruling out scheduling or image-pull issues.
- `k8s_get_pod_logs` (pod eval-crashloop-7977dcfd94-mpt95): logs contain exactly `FATAL: environment variable REQUIRED_SETTING is not set`, confirming the container's own startup check is failing.

## Likely cause
Missing required environment variable. The Deployment's startup script exits with code 1 unless `REQUIRED_SETTING` is set, but the Deployment spec defines no environment variables (no `env`, no `envFrom`, no referenced ConfigMap/Secret supplying `REQUIRED_SETTING`). The container therefore fails on every start, the kubelet backs off restarts, and the pod never becomes Ready — leaving the rollout unavailable.

## Owner and next steps
- Owner: the team/application owner of the `eval-crashloop` workload (per binding `gitlab-whisky`), who manages its Deployment manifest.
- Next steps: add the `REQUIRED_SETTING` environment variable to the container spec (e.g. a literal `env` entry, or an `envFrom` referencing the appropriate ConfigMap/Secret holding the setting). Alternatively, if the variable is no longer required, update the startup command. After applying the manifest change, verify the pod reaches `Ready` and the Deployment reports `Available=True`.
- (Read-only investigation only; no changes were made.)

## Confidence
High — the failing condition is confirmed directly by the pod's own logs (`FATAL: environment variable REQUIRED_SETTING is not set`) and matches the startup command in the live Deployment spec; BackOff events and the `Error`/restart counts corroborate the crash loop.
